WHY I’M RUNNING
## Forward. Together.
The choices Walnut Creek makes today on housing, traffic, public safety, and growth will shape the future of our community for years to come.
This is not a time for business as usual.
I’m running for City Council because Walnut Creek needs steady, transparent leadership focused on practical results. My experience in planning, nonprofit leadership, and small business has shown me how local policy affects everyday life, from how people get around town, to whether families can afford to stay here, to whether our neighborhoods continue to feel safe, welcoming, and vibrant.
My mission is clear: improve mobility, support affordability, protect Walnut Creek’s livability, and plan thoughtfully for the future while preserving the character that makes our city special.
Learn more
### Meet Brendan
Brendan is a husband, father, and Walnut Creek resident who believes strong communities are built through service and accountability.
Brendan has dedicated years to local civic and nonprofit work, supporting libraries, the arts, and responsible city planning. With deep roots in the community and a steady, common-sense approach, he’s focused on listening to residents and helping guide Walnut Creek with care, integrity, and long-term vision.
Learn more
# Volunteer with us
Our campaign is powered by neighbors who care about Walnut Creek and want to make a positive difference right here at home. We welcome volunteers of all kinds, from helping spread the word in your neighborhood to lending your skills behind the scenes.
We are also grateful for endorsements and the support of community leaders who share our vision. If you believe local voices matter and want to be part of a respectful, people-powered effort, we would be honored to have you join us.
Learn more
This is a grassroots, community-powered campaign. Because local laws limit donation amounts, small contributions from neighbors make all the difference. Even a modest donation helps us reach voters and keep this campaign focused on Walnut Creek.
Donate
# Support the Campaign

## Ways to Donate
### Donate Online (PayPal or Credit Card)
Make a secure online contribution using PayPal or a credit card. This option is fast, easy, and works well on desktop or mobile.
### Donate with ActBlue
You may also contribute through ActBlue, a trusted platform many supporters already use for political donations.
Donate with ActBlue
### Donate by Check
You can also support the campaign by mailing a check.
Please make checks payable to:
Brendan Moran for Walnut Creek City Council
Mail to:
1937 2nd Ave. Walnut Creek, CA 94597
(Include occupation and employer as required by California law.)
## Donate to the Campaign
#### This campaign is powered entirely by neighbors like you.
Walnut Creek has strict campaign finance laws that limit how much any one person can contribute. That means Brendan’s campaign depends on many small donations from individual supporters, not large checks or special interests. Every contribution helps us share our message, reach voters, and run a thoughtful, community-focused campaign.
Maximum contribution: $230 per individual
(as set by Walnut Creek campaign finance rules)
Please note that campaign contributions are not tax-deductible, but they are a meaningful way to support local leadership and help shape the future of Walnut Creek.
## Why Your Support Matters
Your donation helps Brendan:
Reach voters through direct, local outreach
Share a clear, thoughtful message about Walnut Creek’s future
Run an independent campaign accountable only to the community
Even a modest contribution makes a real difference in a grassroots city council race.
Thank you for supporting local leadership and being part of this campaign.
